sub: Week 11, Nov 4 to 7. Four days, no activities. Revised Wednesday: pizza night.

days.note: Frozen pizza night, and the Halloween candy and leftover cookies are dessert. Groceries should arrive by 5:30, and tonight gets tomorrow ready.
am: Groceries due by 5:30 CT: put the cold items away first, then check the order against the list.
pm: Check that the whole chicken is raw and thawed in the fridge (never frozen). Leave it there for the morning.
Set out for the crockpot: quarter 1 onion and mix the spices (2 tsp salt, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp pepper) in a small cup.
Assemble the 5 yogurt parfait cups for Thursday breakfast (yogurt and banana slices, granola in a separate cup) and put them in the fridge.
Mix the ranch yogurt dip (3/4 cup plain Greek yogurt plus 1 tbsp ranch seasoning) for Thursday and Friday snacks.
Toss the cooked pork and chicken left from Week 10 (8 to 9 days old).
meals: Halloween candy and leftover chocolate chip cookies

days.note: The whole chicken cooks itself all day, and Friday lunch and dinner both run on the leftovers.
am: Whole chicken into the slow cooker by 9:30: onion on the bottom, chicken on top, seasoned, low for 7 to 8 hours. It must be raw and thawed, never frozen.
Breakfast is the parfait cups from last night. Grab and go.
Make the tortilla pizzas for lunch (8 minutes at 425), cool and pack the middle and youngest lunches. The adults eat theirs at home.
Pack the snacks: mandarin and string cheese for the morning, carrots, ranch dip and pretzels for after school.
pm: 5:00 pm: cook the rice and roast the broccoli (20 minutes) while the chicken rests. Chicken is done at 165 in the thickest part of the thigh.
After dinner: pull ALL the leftover chicken off the bones and refrigerate within 2 hours (about 4 cups for Friday).
Tonight: assemble the 5 jars of Maple Brown Sugar overnight oats for Friday.
meals: Greek yogurt parfaits with granola and banana
Carrots, ranch yogurt dip and pretzels
Crockpot whole chicken, rice, roasted broccoli

days.note: Oats are ready, and Thursday's chicken becomes lunch and tonight's alfredo.
am: Grab the Maple Brown Sugar oat jars and top with chopped pecans and a tiny maple drizzle.
Make the chicken salad for the adults and pack the kid chicken boxes (2 cups of Thursday's chicken).
Set aside the other 2 cups of cold chicken for tonight's alfredo.
Pack the snacks: yogurt cup and granola for the morning, popcorn, cheese and grapes for after school.
pm: 4:45 pm: roast the broccoli, boil the fettuccine and make the alfredo sauce (25 minutes).
Tonight: move the salmon from the freezer to the fridge to thaw for Saturday.
Tonight: assemble the 5 jars of Peanut Butter Banana overnight oats for Saturday.
meals: Chicken salad (adults) and kid chicken boxes
White cheddar popcorn, cheese and grapes
One pot plus a sheet pan, 25 minutes

days.note: Everyone is home, so brownies bake in the morning and dinner is a 25 minute salmon sheet pan.
am: Grab the Peanut Butter Banana oat jars and top with banana slices and chocolate chips.
Check that the salmon is thawed in the fridge.
Bake the brownie bites after breakfast (20 minutes) so they cool before dessert.
Make the shells and cheese for lunch with steamed broccoli and apple slices.
pm: 4:45 pm: oven to 425, roast the frozen stir-fry veggies and the glazed salmon on two pans and start the rice (25 minutes).
After dinner: eyeball what is left in the fridge and pantry for next week's ledger.
meals: Shells and cheese with broccoli and apple slices
Soy-maple salmon over rice with roasted veggies

chicken_cp.t: Crockpot whole chicken, rice and roasted broccoli
chicken_cp.s: Serves 6 with leftover chicken for Friday
ing: 1 whole chicken, 5 to 6 lb, raw and thawed (never frozen)
2 cups long grain white rice and 4 cups water
1 tbsp olive oil and a pinch of salt for the broccoli
st: Put the onion in the slow cooker. Pat the chicken dry, rub with the oil and spices and set it breast side up on the onion. Pour the water around it.
Cook on low 7 to 8 hours (or high 4 to 5) until 165 in the thickest part of the thigh.
Cook the rice with the water and butter. Roast the frozen broccoli at 425 with the oil and salt for 18 minutes. Let the chicken rest 15 minutes and serve legs, thighs and some breast.
After dinner pull ALL the remaining meat off the bones and refrigerate within 2 hours (about 4 cups: 2 for Friday's chicken salad lunch and 2 for Friday's alfredo).

parfait.t: Greek yogurt parfaits with granola and banana
st: Stir the vanilla into the yogurt.
Layer yogurt, banana and granola in cups. Pack the granola separately if eating on the go.
Pack or plate as listed.

chicken_salad.t: Chicken salad (adults) and kid chicken boxes
chicken_salad.s: Serves 6 (2 adults, 3 kid boxes plus a spare)
ing: Adult salad: 1 cup chopped chicken (from Thursday's crockpot chicken), 1/4 cup mayo, 1 tbsp grainy mustard, 2 celery ribs diced, 1 tbsp lemon juice, salt and pepper, 4 slices bread
Kid boxes: 1 cup shredded plain chicken, 1 cup cheddar cubes, 1 1/2 cups Cheez-Its, 2 cups grapes
st: Stir the salad ingredients together and serve on bread.
Divide the kid chicken, cheese, Cheez-Its and grapes into boxes. Keep the chicken cold in the lunchbox.

s_carrot_dip.t: Carrots, ranch yogurt dip and pretzels
ing: 3 tbsp ranch dip (3/4 cup plain Greek yogurt plus 1 tbsp ranch seasoning for all 5)
st: Stir the ranch seasoning into the yogurt and pack in small cups.

alfredo.t: Chicken fettuccine alfredo with roasted broccoli
ing: 2 cups shredded chicken (from Thursday's crockpot chicken)
1 can (12 oz) fat free evaporated milk
st: Roast the broccoli on a sheet pan at 425 with the olive oil and a pinch of salt for 18 minutes.
Boil the fettuccine and drain.
Whisk the cornstarch into the evaporated milk, warm it with the butter and garlic powder over medium, stir 3 to 4 minutes until thick, then stir in the Parmesan, salt and pepper.
Toss the pasta and chicken in the sauce and serve with broccoli.

ing: 1 box (1 oz) sugar-free chocolate pudding mix
st: Whisk the pudding mix with the milk for 1 minute, then stir in the yogurt until smooth.
Spoon into cups, chill 10 minutes and top with chips.

ing: Pinch of salt in each jar
Topping: 10 tbsp chopped pecans or walnuts and at most 1/2 tsp extra maple per jar
st: Per jar: 3/4 cup oats, 1 cup milk, 1 tbsp chia, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 tsp maple, 3/4 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt. Add everything except the nuts and stir well, working the peanut butter in.
Refrigerate overnight (Thursday night).
Morning: stir, top with 2 tbsp chopped nuts and a tiny maple drizzle if needed.
Pack the granola separately.

ing: 2 cups shredded mozzarella (grate from the block)
1 bell pepper cut into strips, for the side
st: Heat the oven to 425. Put the tortillas on two sheet pans and bake 2 minutes to crisp the base.
Spread with sauce, top with cheese and seasoning and bake 6 to 8 minutes until bubbly. Cool before packing.
Serve with pepper strips.

s_popcorn.t: White cheddar popcorn, cheese and grapes
st: Pack or plate as listed.

salmon.t: Soy-maple salmon over rice with roasted veggies
ing: 2 lb salmon fillets, thawed in the fridge
1 bag frozen stir-fry veggies, roasted (not stir-fried)
1 tbsp olive oil and 1/2 tsp salt for the veggies
2 cups long grain white rice and 4 cups water
st: Heat the oven to 425. Cook the rice.
Roast the frozen veggies on one pan with 1 tbsp oil and the salt for 15 to 18 minutes.
Whisk the aminos, maple, 1 tbsp oil and garlic powder, put the salmon on a second pan and brush on the glaze. Roast 10 to 12 minutes until it flakes (145). Serve over rice with the veggies.

ing: 2 cans (15 oz) peaches in juice, drained and chopped
st: Stir the cinnamon and vanilla into the yogurt.
Layer peaches and yogurt in cups and top with granola.

ing: Pinch of salt in each jar
Topping: 1 banana, sliced, and optional 5 tbsp mini chocolate chips
st: Per jar: 3/4 cup oats, 1 cup milk, 1 tbsp chia, 1/2 mashed banana, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt. Mash the banana in the jar first, add the rest and stir well.
Refrigerate overnight (Friday night).
Morning: stir, top with banana slices and chocolate chips for whoever wants them.
Spread and top.

shells.t: Shells and cheese with broccoli and apple slices
ing: 2 boxes (about 6 oz each) shells and cheese
Milk and butter as the box directs (use 2% milk)
st: Make the shells and cheese as the box directs.
Steam the broccoli 5 minutes and stir half of it into the pasta.
Serve with the rest of the broccoli and apple slices.
Pack or plate as listed.
Heat the oven to 350 and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk the butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla, then stir in the dry ingredients and chips.
Fill the cups and bake 18 to 20 minutes. Cool in the tin. Serve 2 each.

method: Pizza night Wed, 1 crockpot night (Thu), 1 quick one-pot night (Fri) and 1 sheet-pan night (Sat). Dinner is on the table about 5:30 every night.
desserts: Wed Halloween candy and leftover cookies, Thu chocolate pudding yogurt cups, Fri peaches and cream cups, Sat cocoa brownie bites.
pantry: Groceries are due Wednesday by 5:30 CT. Put cold items away first.
Whole chicken: confirm it is raw and thawed in the fridge (not frozen) before Thursday 9:30.
Toss the cooked pork and chicken left from Week 10 (8 to 9 days old).
Frozen salmon: move to the fridge Friday night for Saturday dinner.
Shrimp stays in the freezer this week (no dinner for it). It is first in line next week.
Shells and cheese: Saturday lunch needs 2 boxes. Check the shelf.
Eggs: about 2 on hand, which Saturday's brownie bites use.
Eyeball before Thursday night: peanut butter (oats need about 20 tbsp across Friday and Saturday), chia, chocolate chips, granola.
Frozen broccoli: the plan uses about 4 bags (Thu 2, Fri 2) plus 1 for Saturday lunch.

items: Bananas, 2 bunches (organic if within $1 of regular). Plan uses about 5 1/2.
Grapes, purple, 2 lb loose, cheapest brand (about 4 1/2 cups on Friday)
Mandarin oranges, 1 bag (10 needed for snacks Thursday and Saturday)
Baby carrots, 1 bag, 2 lb (Thursday dip snack)
Bell peppers, 3-count multipack (Thursday pizza strips, plus the middle kiddo's snack)
Plain Greek yogurt, 2 tubs, 32 oz each (about 6 3/4 cups: parfaits, dip, pudding cups, peaches)
Flavored Greek yogurt cups, 1 four-pack (Friday snack needs 5, about 2 on hand)
String cheese, 1 pack of 12 (15 sticks needed, about 11 on hand)
Mozzarella, 16 oz block (tortilla pizzas need 8 oz, about 4 oz on hand)
Cheddar, 16 oz block (weekly staple, kid chicken boxes use 4 oz)
2% milk, 1 gallon (oats use 10 cups, plus shells and pudding)
Half & half, 16 oz carton (weekly staple)
Eggs, organic, 1 dozen (brownies need 2; this is a 4-day week, so 1 dozen, not the usual 2 to 3)
Old-fashioned oats, 1 canister (7 1/2 cups needed for Friday and Saturday oats, about half a canister on hand)
Granola, 1 bag (about 2 3/4 cups needed)
Peanut butter, 1 jar (about 24 tbsp needed, about 9 on hand)
Chia seeds, 1 bag (10 tbsp needed, probably low)
Pecans or walnuts, 1 small bag (10 tbsp chopped for Friday's oats)
Pretzels, 1 bag (about 100 pretzels needed, about 6 oz on hand)
Marinara, 24 oz jar (tortilla pizzas, the jar on hand is borderline)
Tortillas, large, 1 package (6 for Thursday's pizzas)
Sandwich bread, 1 loaf (chicken salad needs 4 slices, about 3 on hand). Nature's Own is your usual, so check whether Aldi has a similar loaf.
Sugar-free chocolate pudding mix, 1 box (Thursday dessert)
Mini chocolate chips, 1 bag (about 1 cup across pudding, rice cakes, brownies and oats)
Canned peaches in juice, 1 can, 15 oz (Friday dessert needs 2, about 1 to 2 on hand)
Shells and cheese, 1 box (Saturday lunch needs 2, you have 1 to 2)
Frozen broccoli florets, 3 bags, 12 oz each (5 bags needed: Thursday 2, Friday 2, Saturday lunch 1, about 2 to 3 on hand)
Frozen cheese pizzas, 2 to 3 large, no pepperoni (tonight's dinner, skip if already in the freezer)

shop.h: Eyeball at home (not on the Aldi list)
items: Whole chicken: raw and thawed in the fridge, not frozen (Thursday)
Frozen salmon and 1 bag frozen stir-fry veggies (Saturday)
Fettuccine, 1 lb, and Parmesan, about 6 oz (Friday alfredo)
Fat free evaporated milk, 1 can, and cornstarch (Friday alfredo)
Rice, about 4 cups dry (Thursday and Saturday)
Apples, 3 (Saturday lunch) and celery, 2 ribs (Friday chicken salad)
Cheez-Its, white cheddar popcorn and ranch seasoning packets (Thursday and Friday snacks)
Cinnamon (about 7 tsp across the oats and peaches), cocoa powder (1/3 cup), maple syrup (5 tsp)
Mayo, grainy mustard, lemon, onion, garlic powder, olive oil, liquid aminos, flour, sugar, baking powder

shop.h: Walmart or Sam's only (skip unless low)
items: Diet Sam's Cola, 4 packs of 12
Sparkling water (no sweeteners)
Rascals training pants, 5T-6T, 16 count
